name: Cafe-Pension Pfeiffer
kurzbeschreibung: Café-Pension Pfeiffer in Krün Discover cozy charm in the heart of the Tirol Alps!
beschreibung: The Cafe-Pension Pfeiffer in Krün near the Tyrolean border provides a welcoming retreat for travelers seeking authentic alpine hospitality. The café serves fresh homemade cakes, strudels, and fragrant coffee specialties in a peaceful, traditional parlor. Guests can enjoy panoramic mountain vistas from the garden terrace while savoring hearty breakfasts or afternoon sweets prepared with regional ingredients.
